title: Verbs of change: how colonial society changed

sections.title: What you already know
sections.content: You know the verbs of change (*ponerse*, *volverse*, *hacerse*, *quedarse*, *convertirse en*) from B1 Unit 25, and also *pasar de ser … a ser …*. They fit the story of the colony, where groups, cities and languages changed over time.

sections.title: Which verb?
rows: se convirtió en un hecho muy importante
*hacerse* + noun: a change reached with time or effort
pasaron de ser un grupo pequeño a ser un grupo grande

items.spanish: El mestizaje se convirtió en un hecho muy importante de la vida colonial.
items.english: Mestizaje became a very important fact of colonial life.

items.spanish: Algunos mestizos se hicieron comerciantes en las ciudades.
items.english: Some mestizos became merchants in the cities.

items.spanish: Los criollos pasaron de ser un grupo pequeño a ser un grupo grande.
items.english: The criollos went from being a small group to being a large group.

items.spanish: Muchos criollos se quedaron sin cargos importantes.
items.english: Many criollos were left without important posts.

sections.content: Choose the verb by the kind of change: *convertirse en* for a big change, *hacerse* for something you become with time or effort, *quedarse* for a result, *pasar de ser … a ser …* to show both ends of the change.
